measurement_self_contamination.interpretation: The exact-value fingerprint procedure D2H-copied/cached the live step0 state into host memory before checkpoint saving. It therefore changed the host-memory condition being measured while leaving the GPU state unchanged.

mechanistic_interpretation.supported: The first B1 qualification is invalid for adjudicating serial-item checkpoint feasibility because its pre-save exact-value measurement materially inflated the same host-memory resource endpoint under test.
mechanistic_interpretation.not_supported: Do not infer that serial-item B1 itself requires more than 96GiB or that the train_state item fails after params completion. The qualification was already at the cgroup ceiling due to measurement-induced host residency before the train_state item produced bytes.

prospective_harness_repair.description: Move pre-save exact-value fingerprinting into a separate fresh-step0 process that exits before the checkpoint-save process starts. Then start a second fresh deterministic step0 process for the unchanged B1 serial-item save. After it exits, use the existing CPU/NumPy verifier to compare restored values against the separately generated reference fingerprints.
prospective_harness_repair.why_same_state: Both reference-fingerprint and save processes are fresh step0 initializations from the same content-addressed pi0.5 base checkpoint, seed42, optimizer initialization, EMA initialization, config, and no data/update path.
